items.name: FrostPylonBot
items.note: Torre alta y delgada, antena recta larga
items.prompt:
Generate ONE 2D game enemy sprite for a dark fantasy mobile roguelite: Tall slim sentry robot with a single long antenna on top of its head. Side view facing right, full body, centered, SQUARE 1:1 image. One single character only: NOT a sprite sheet, no animation frames, no variations.

Cold saturated palette of deep blues, icy whites, pale blue-grey stone and frosted steel. Cyan/turquoise accents only on crystals and eyes. Painted digital illustration, stylized semi-realistic, slight texture, no grain/haze outside the character.

CHARACTER: Narrow upright capsule body in matte steel grey with white frost patches, a small round visor eye, thruster pod underneath. One tall straight antenna on top ending in a small ball. Calm, watchful. The antenna is a plain idle antenna: no laser beam, no light ray, no energy drawn coming out of it. A robotic floating machine, metal and mechanical (never an organic animal): it hovers because of a hover device (a thruster, jet or ring that blasts fire, vapour or energy downward). NO legs, NO feet, nothing touches the ground, it is airborne. Use the zone's colour palette only: its materials follow the creature's own nature (a robot stays metal, an animal stays an animal) and it is NOT covered in snow, ice, leaves or rock unless the design says so. It carries 1-3 glowing turquoise-cyan ice crystals: One crystal grows at the antenna tip and one on the chest panel; they power the antenna.

ATTACK: It attacks with MAGIC, but the picture shows NO weapon, NO staff, nothing held and NO spell effect: just the plain creature in its calm idle form. The part it casts with (hand, mouth, horn…) is drawn normally, closed or relaxed; a different version of that part will be drawn later to cast. Its casting part is the antenna: draw it plainly, in its idle form.

POSE (the character will be cut into separate pieces afterwards, so EVERY piece must be fully visible): Calm hovering pose, the body in the middle with the hover device clearly visible below or around it. The hover device is its own closed shape and is not hidden behind the body. Each piece is one closed shape with its own full outline and a clearly visible contour where it touches the next one (the character is cut into separate pieces afterwards). PIECES — exactly these 3, no more (no extra limbs, hands, weapons or loose parts; each piece joins its neighbour at a visible joint and has a clearly visible contour where they touch):
1. Body (torso, the machine's shell)
2. Head or sensor (only if the design has one)
